key.name: skin
key.summary: Skin of the shell-side UI
key.description: Which UI variant and stylesheet the bridge uses for its panels. Themes set it in their look module (desk.dconf).

key.name: language
key.summary: Interface language
key.description: 'system' follows the session locale (LANGUAGE, LC_MESSAGES); 'uk' or 'en' overrides it for desktop-themes-rs only (the window, the themes command, deskd and desk-bridge).

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Record clipboard history
key.description: Turn off to disable the feature completely

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Maximum number of unpinned items
key.description: How many unpinned items to keep

key.name: images
key.summary: Record images
key.description: Also record copied images

key.name: image-max-kb
key.summary: Largest image recorded, in KiB
key.description: Bigger images are not recorded

key.name: image-budget-mb
key.summary: Total size of the images in the history, in MiB (oldest images are dropped first)
key.description: Images wait in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (memory), so their total is capped; nothing is written when that directory is nearly full.

key.name: persist
key.summary: Keep text history across sessions
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/clipboard (mode 0600).

key.name: persist-images
key.summary: Keep images across sessions
key.description: Off by default: images live only in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR while the session runs.

key.name: private-mode
key.summary: Private mode: record nothing
key.description: Temporarily record nothing

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the selected item into the focused window
key.description: After you choose an item it is pasted into the window you were working in

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the clipboard panel (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Super+V for Windows 11, Shift+Super+V for macOS); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts clipboard-toggle replaces it and is re-applied after every theme apply. Change it in the window (Keyboard shortcuts) or with `themes shortcut`.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications whose copies are never recorded (WM class or app id)

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable the emoji and symbol picker
key.description: Open a keyboard-first panel to search and insert emoji, symbols and text faces

key.name: emoji-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the emoji and symbol picker (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Super+. and Super+; for Windows 11, Ctrl+Super+Space for macOS, Super+. for Fedora); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts emoji-toggle replaces it. The key is not called toggle-shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: skin-tone
key.summary: Default Fitzpatrick skin-tone modifier for person emoji
key.description: Applied to person and hand emoji when inserted

key.name: remember-recents
key.summary: Keep recently picked emoji and symbols across sessions
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/emoji.json (mode 0600, last 36 picked). Turning it off clears the list and deletes the file.

key.name: close-after-insert
key.summary: Whether the emoji picker closes after inserting an item
key.description: 'skin': windows11 stays open while macos and default close; 'always': close in every skin; 'never': keep open until dismissed.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable the colour picker
key.description: Pick the colour of any pixel on the screen with a magnifying loupe

key.name: format
key.summary: Text format of picked colours
key.description: deskd formats picks and the history in this format (theme_tokens::picker).

key.name: zoom
key.summary: Magnification of the loupe (4x to 16x)
key.description: The scroll wheel and the + and - keys change it while picking

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Number of picked colours kept in the history (0 = none)
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/colors.json (mode 0600), newest first. 0 keeps no history: the list is cleared and the file is deleted.

key.name: copy-on-pick
key.summary: Copy the picked colour to the clipboard
key.description: Put the picked colour on the clipboard in the chosen format

key.name: color-picker-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that starts the colour picker (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Shift+Super+C for Windows 11 and Fedora, Ctrl+Shift+Super+C for macOS); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts color-picker-toggle replaces it. The key is not called toggle-shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable the OCR text extractor
key.description: Select a region of the screen and copy the text in it, recognised locally

key.name: languages
key.summary: Tesseract language codes used for recognition
key.description: Codes as `tesseract --list-langs` prints them. Codes without installed data are left out and named in the result toast; recognition runs with the others.

key.name: record-in-history
key.summary: Put recognised text into the clipboard history
key.description: False: the text is still copied to the clipboard, but the clipboard history does not record it (as in private mode).

key.name: keep-line-breaks
key.summary: Keep the line breaks inside paragraphs
key.description: Paragraph breaks are always kept; words broken with a hyphen at a line end are joined.

key.name: max-megapixels
key.summary: Largest region that is recognised, in megapixels
key.description: deskd refuses an image with width × height above this value × 1 000 000.

key.name: ocr-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that starts the text extractor (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Shift+Super+T for Windows 11 and Fedora, Ctrl+Shift+Super+T for macOS); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts ocr-toggle replaces it. The key is not called toggle-shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable screenshots and screen recording
key.description: Off: the bridge binds no capture shortcut and deskd refuses to save captures.

key.name: save-folder
key.summary: Folder for saved screenshots (empty = ~/Pictures/Screenshots)
key.description: Empty: Screenshots in the XDG pictures folder (~/Pictures/Screenshots). A leading ~ is the home folder; another relative path is taken from the home folder. The folder is created when needed.

key.name: copy-to-clipboard
key.summary: Copy each capture to the clipboard
key.description: Put each screenshot on the clipboard as well as in the folder

key.name: show-preview
key.summary: Show the thumbnail or notification after a capture
key.description: The macos skin shows a floating thumbnail for 6 s, the windows11 skin a notification with an Edit button; the default skin keeps GNOME's notification.

key.name: delay
key.summary: Delay before a capture, in seconds
key.description: Wait with a visible countdown before the capture

key.name: include-pointer
key.summary: Include the mouse pointer
key.description: Include the pointer in screenshots and recordings

key.name: record-format
key.summary: Container and codec of screen recordings
key.description: Encoded by GNOME's screencast service. MP4 needs an H.264 encoder, which Fedora does not ship by default; WebM always works.

key.name: record-audio
key.summary: Audio sources of screen recordings
key.description: Off by default; the microphone is recorded only when you choose it here

key.name: annotate-after-capture
key.summary: Open the annotation editor after each capture
key.description: Mark up each screenshot (pen, arrows, redaction, crop) before you keep it

key.name: capture-region-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that captures a region (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default from desk.dconf (Windows 11: Shift+Super+S; macOS: Shift+Super+4; Fedora: none, GNOME's Print stays). An override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts capture-region replaces it. The name ends in -shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: capture-screen-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that captures the whole screen (in force)
key.description: Windows 11: Super+Print; macOS: Shift+Super+3; Fedora: none, GNOME's Shift+Print stays. Override: io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts capture-screen.

key.name: capture-toolbar-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the capture toolbar (in force)
key.description: Windows 11: Print; macOS: Shift+Super+5; Fedora: none, GNOME's screenshot UI stays. Override: io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts capture-toolbar.

key.name: capture-record-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that starts or stops a screen recording (in force)
key.description: Windows 11: Shift+Super+R; macOS: none (record from the Shift+Super+5 toolbar); Fedora: none, GNOME's Ctrl+Shift+Alt+R stays. Override: io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts capture-record.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable window snap layouts and always-on-top
key.description: Off: deskd refuses layout calls and the bridge binds no layout shortcut.

key.name: layout-picker-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the window layout picker (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default from desk.dconf (Windows 11 and Fedora: Super+Z; macOS: Ctrl+Super+Up). An override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts layout-picker replaces it. The name ends in -shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: always-on-top-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that toggles always-on-top for the focused window (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds (default: Ctrl+Super+T, as PowerToys Always on Top). An override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts always-on-top replaces it.

key.name: gap-outer
key.summary: Outer gap around snapped windows, in logical pixels
key.description: Even pixels from 0 to 64. Windows 11 uses 8 px; Fedora uses 0 px.

key.name: gap-inner
key.summary: Inner gap between adjacent snapped windows, in logical pixels
key.description: Even pixels from 0 to 64. Windows 11 uses 6 px; Fedora uses 0 px.

key.name: snap-assist
key.summary: Offer other windows to fill remaining snap zones
key.description: On by default in Windows 11; off by default in macOS.

key.name: hover-picker
key.summary: Show the layout picker when hovering the maximise button
key.description: On by default in Windows 11; off by default in macOS and Fedora.

key.name: clipboard-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the clipboard panel (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: emoji-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the emoji and symbol picker (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: mixer-open
key.summary: Your shortcut for the volume mixer (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: color-picker-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the colour picker (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: ocr-toggle
key.summary: Your shortcut for the text extractor (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: capture-region
key.summary: Your shortcut for a region capture (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: capture-screen
key.summary: Your shortcut for a full-screen capture (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: capture-toolbar
key.summary: Your shortcut for the capture toolbar (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: capture-record
key.summary: Your shortcut for screen recording (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: layout-picker
key.summary: Your shortcut for the window layout picker (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: always-on-top
key.summary: Your shortcut for always-on-top (override)
key.description: Empty: follow the active theme. ['disabled']: no shortcut. Anything else wins over the theme default and is kept when the theme changes.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Enable the volume mixer
key.description: Volume of each application and the choice of output and input devices

key.name: entry-point
key.summary: Where the mixer opens
key.description: 'menu': inside the volume menu of quick settings only; 'menu-and-icon': a secondary click on the system area of the top bar opens it directly as well.

key.name: show-silent-apps
key.summary: List applications with a paused audio stream
key.description: Also list applications that keep a sound stream open without playing

key.name: remember-app-volume
key.summary: Restore the volume set for an application when it plays again
key.description: Stored in ~/.local/share/deskd/mixer/apps.json (mode 0600): application ids with a volume and a mute flag. Turning it off forgets them and deletes the file.

key.name: volume-step
key.summary: Slider step for the arrow keys, in percent
key.description: How much an arrow key changes a slider (Shift: 1 %)

key.name: hide-apps
key.summary: Application keys (app id or program name) never listed in the mixer
key.description: Applications never listed in the mixer (app id or program name)

key.name: mixer-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens the volume mixer (in force)
key.description: The accelerators the bridge binds. Themes write their default here from desk.dconf (Ctrl+Super+V for Windows 11; none for macOS and Fedora, which have no such key); an override in io.github.OlehDzhumyk.Desk.Shortcuts mixer-open replaces it. The key is not called toggle-shortcut because shell keybinding names are global.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Draw the volume and brightness OSD in the style of the skin
key.description: Off, or with the default skin, the stock GNOME Shell OSD is used and the bridge does not touch Main.osdWindowManager.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show the level as a number
key.description: The number next to the level bar; high contrast always shows it

key.name: timeout-ms
key.summary: Milliseconds after the last change before the OSD hides
key.description: A repeated key press restarts this one timer; it does not open a second OSD.

key.name: position
key.summary: Position of the OSD on the monitor
key.description: Where on the monitor with the pointer the display appears

key.name: mode
key.summary: Colour scheme mode
key.description: How deskd manages org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme: 'manual' leaves it alone, 'light' and 'dark' keep it fixed, 'auto-sun' follows local sunrise and sunset, and 'auto-time' switches at dark-from and light-from.

key.name: dark-from
key.summary: Time to switch to dark mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)
key.description: Time to switch to dark mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)

key.name: light-from
key.summary: Time to switch to light mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)
key.description: Time to switch to light mode (HH:MM, 24-hour)

key.name: location
key.summary: City name or coordinates (lat,lon) for sunrise and sunset
key.description: Used locally to compute sunrise and sunset (no network requests). Accepts a city name from the built-in table or decimal coordinates 'lat,lon'; empty falls back to the system timezone.

key.name: twilight-offset
key.summary: Shift sunrise and sunset earlier (negative) or later (positive), in minutes
key.description: Shift sunrise and sunset earlier (negative) or later (positive)

key.name: override-until-next
key.summary: Keep manual light/dark changes until the next scheduled transition
key.description: If you switch light or dark manually, wait until the next sunrise or sunset before switching back

key.name: accent-from-wallpaper
key.summary: The desktop accent colour follows the current wallpaper
key.description: When on, deskd watches org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri and picture-uri-dark and sets org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color to the GNOME named accent nearest the wallpaper's seed colour. The image is decoded by a `themes tokens seed` child process. Turning it off restores the accent that was in force before.

key.name: accent-source
key.summary: Which wallpaper variant gives the accent colour
key.description: 'active' uses picture-uri-dark when color-scheme is 'prefer-dark' and picture-uri otherwise; 'light' always uses picture-uri; 'dark' always uses picture-uri-dark.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Focus modes and their schedules are on
key.description: Off: deskd ends the active mode (restoring what it changed) and arms no schedule.

key.name: active-mode
key.summary: Id of the active focus mode (written by deskd; empty: none)
key.description: A mirror of deskd's state for display and recovery: if the state file is lost while this is set, deskd restores the notification banners at start-up. Start and end modes with `themes focus`, the window or the quick settings tile, not by writing this key.

key.name: summary-on-end
key.summary: Show the number of missed notifications when a focus mode ends
key.description: Tell how many notifications arrived while the mode was on

key.name: session-length
key.summary: Length of a focus session, in minutes
key.description: Length of a focus session (Windows 11 style)

key.name: session-break
key.summary: Break after a focus session, in minutes (0: none)
key.description: 0: no break

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show the logo menu on the left of the top bar in the macOS skin
key.description: Show a system menu on the left of the top bar in the macOS skin.

key.name: hide-activities
key.summary: Hide the default Activities indicator while the logo menu is shown
key.description: Hide the default Activities indicator while the logo menu is shown.
